s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing vascular tumor on the scalp
salient_findings: 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp
Irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa on dermoscopic evaluation
Well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 40s
The patient has no significant medical history
The tumor is located on the left temporal scalp
The tumor is 8-mm in size
The tumor is red, firm, and mobile
Dermoscopic evaluation showed irregular red lacunae without septa and irregular linear vessels
Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor
The tumor extends to the superficial subcutaneous tissue
The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
The structures are covered by swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
PAS staining showed positive hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
Tumor vessels were positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40 and HHV-8

shortlist.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules, consistent with glomeruloid hemangioma

shortlist.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Dermoscopic evaluation showed irregular red lacunae without septa and irregular linear vessels, and histopathology showed papillary structures, which are features of papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma

shortlist.label: Hobnail hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and swollen endothelial cells, which are features of hobnail hemangioma

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and swollen endothelial cells, which are features of epithelioid hemangioma

shortlist.label: Dabska tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures, which are features of Dabska tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of intracytoplasmic hyaline globules in endothelial cells, positivity for CD-31, and the characteristic papillary structures with ectatic thin-walled vessels are consistent with Dabska tumor.

rejected.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
rejected.why: While it also presents with hyaline globules, the specific vascular architecture and immunohistochemical profile do not fully match the case description.

rejected.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
rejected.why: This condition typically involves lymphatic vessels and would be expected to be positive for D2-40, which is not the case here.

rejected.label: Hobnail hemangioma
rejected.why: It lacks the distinctive intravascular papillary structures and hyaline globules seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
rejected.why: The histological features and immunohistochemical profile, particularly the presence of hyaline globules and specific vascular architecture, are not characteristic of epithelioid hemangioma.
